amendment_history.decree: قرار وزير الصناعة والثروة المعدنية رقم (1006/1/1442)
amendment_history.note: الإصدار التأسيسي للائحة التنفيذية لنظام الاستثمار التعديني، صادر بقرار وزير الصناعة والثروة المعدنية استناداً لنظام الاستثمار التعديني (المرسوم الملكي رقم م/140 وتاريخ 19/10/1441هـ)، ونُشر كاملاً في الجريدة الرسمية (أم القرى) بتاريخ 17/5/1442هـ الموافق 1/1/2021م. هذا هو النص المخزَّن بالكامل في هذا المسار (166 مادة عبر 7 أبواب)، مأخوذ مباشرة من صفحة اللائحة الرسمية ذاتها على uqn.gov.sa (عبر أرشيف Wayback Machine، الصفحة الحية أعادت قالب SPA عاماً دون محتوى هذه الجولة).

amendment_history.decree: قرار وزير الصناعة والثروة المعدنية رقم (3293/1/1444)
amendment_history.note: تعديل مؤكَّد الوجود -- قُرئ نص قرار الموافقة على التعديل نفسه مباشرة من صفحته الرسمية على أم القرى (عبر أرشيف Wayback Machine لعنوان uqn.gov.sa/?p=21989)، ويستند إلى قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (100) وتاريخ 3/2/1444هـ. ينص بند القرار الأول صراحة على أن نص التعديل الفعلي مرفق بصيغة منفصلة ('بالصيغة المرافقة لهذا القرار') لم تُدرَج على صفحة الخبر الرسمية ذاتها، ولم يتسنَّ الحصول عليها عبر أي قناة أخرى جُرِّبت هذه الجولة (انظر known_unresolved_discrepancies). رقم القرار وتاريخه مؤكَّدان عبر تصالب مصدر ثانوي (بحث الويب) يطابق تكليف هذه الجولة تماماً؛ جوهر القرار ومقدمته وبنوده الثلاثة وتوقيع الوزير مقروءة مباشرة من مصدر أساسي أرشيفي. لم يُدمَج أي تعديل على مستوى المادة المفردة في هذا المسار نتيجة لذلك -- قيد صريح مُفصح عنه، لا فبركة أو تخمين.

gazette_publication.citation_ar: تاريخ النشر مأخوذ حرفياً من صفحة اللائحة الرسمية ذاتها على uqn.gov.sa (جريدة أم القرى)، التي تعرض أعلى نصها الحقل: '1442-5-17 الموافق 2021-01-01'. هذا تاريخ نشر الجريدة، ويقع بعد تاريخ صدور القرار الوزاري ذاته (9/5/1442هـ) بثمانية أيام هجرية، وهو فارق زمني معقول ومتسق مع دورة نشر الجريدة الرسمية المعتادة لقرار صدر لتوّه.

verification_methodology_note:
PRIMARY SOURCE ACCESS -- ORIGINAL DECISION (uqn.gov.sa/?p=2083): the live page returned the site's generic single-page-application shell on direct fetch this pass (both a raw curl GET, HTTP 200, and the WebFetch tool, HTTP 503) -- the site is a Vue/Blazor-style SPA that renders article content client-side and does not serve it in the initial HTML response for this exact URL/query-string pattern. archive.org/wayback/available was queried for this exact URL and returned a confirmed snapshot (timestamp 20251011171315, Oct 2025); this track fetched that snapshot directly via curl using the archive's raw ('id_') rendering (HTTP 200, ~740KB), which -- unlike the live SPA shell -- IS a server-rendered Blazor page carrying the full WordPress-era Gutenberg-block HTML body inline ( / comments preserved verbatim from the underlying CMS content, confirming this is the site's own authored regulation text, not a third-party mirror). The page's own visible date field reads '1442-5-17 الموافق 2021-01-01' (Umm Al-Qura gazette publication date). The archived HTML was parsed with BeautifulSoup (not naive regex/tag-stripping): every

and element within the page's own content container was walked in strict document order; each
(there are 11 in the full captured page, ALL but one confined to the six numbered appendices/ملاحق at the very end of the document, after Article 166) was converted row-by-row into pipe-delimited prose lines (header row retained where it carries genuine column-meaning, e.g. ore type / license term / amount -- never naive tag-stripped, which would have silently reordered or merged cell content). 166 sequential 'المادة ...:' headings were located this way, spanning 7 أبواب and (within Bab 1-5) نested فصول -- see chapter_structure. The ONE table appearing inside the 166-article body itself (inside Article 86, السادسة والثمانون -- a rehabilitation/closure cost schedule for building-material licenses) was merged inline into that article's own text at its correct position, immediately after the sentence that introduces it ('حسب الجدول التالي:'). Total extracted body: preamble line + 166 articles, ending cleanly at Article 166's own closing sentence, immediately followed by 'ملحق رقم (1)' (Appendix 1) -- confirming no truncation before the appendices begin. SCOPE DECISION -- APPENDICES (ملاحق) EXCLUDED FROM THE ARTICLE COLLECTION: the regulation's own text is followed by 6 numbered ملاحق (mineral category tables A/B/C; per-category financial-consideration/royalty-rate tables; surface-rental fee schedule; minimum annual exploration-spending schedule) -- these are referenced BY specific articles (e.g. Article 110.2: 'يحسب الإيجار السطحي لرخص مواد البناء وفقاً لما هو موضح في الملحق رقم (3)') but are themselves numeric schedules, not additional 'مواد' (numbered articles) in the regulation's own numbering scheme. Consistent with this corpus's convention that the atomic retrieval unit is the numbered المادة, this track's 'articles' collection covers exactly the 166 numbered مواد and does NOT create synthetic article-like records for the 6 ملاحق -- a deliberate, disclosed scope boundary, not lost or truncated content (all 6 ملاحق were successfully captured in the same source fetch and are available in this pass's raw working data; they were intentionally not modeled as 'articles'). SUBSTANTIVE CROSS-VERIFICATION AGAINST INDEPENDENT PRESS SOURCES: argaam.com's own article on this regulation (one of this task's original source leads, read via the WebFetch tool) paraphrases two specific provisions; both were located VERBATIM in the extracted text and match exactly in substance: (1) argaam's 'the minister may, after coordination with relevant government agencies, designate land or marine areas as mining reserve zones' matches Article 11.1 verbatim ('للوزير بعد التنسيق مع الجهات الحكومية المختصة، أن يخصص أي أرض أو منطقة بحرية كمنطقة احتياطي تعديني'); (2) argaam's 'Category B minerals may be exported in natural form with a 10% financial fee on net sales, capped at 30% of average annual production capacity' matches Article 135.3 verbatim ('يجوز تصدير المعادن والخامات لأغراض تجارية بحالتها الطبيعية لمعادن الفئة (ب) بشرط أن يدفع المرخص له مقابلاً مالياً للتصدير نسبته (10٪) من صافي مبيعات المعدن ... على ألّا تتجاوز نسبة التصدير (30٪) من متوسط الطاقة الإنتاجية الفعلية السنوية'). This is treated as independent substantive corroboration of the extracted primary text's authenticity (not merely citation-level agreement), from a source this task itself designated as a lead. PRIMARY SOURCE ACCESS -- AMENDMENT DECISION (uqn.gov.sa/?p=21989): same SPA-shell issue on direct live fetch this pass (curl HTTP 200 generic shell; WebFetch HTTP 503). archive.org/wayback/available returned a confirmed snapshot (timestamp 20230507072534, May 2023, close in time to the amendment's own datePublished metadata of 2023-02-10T15:00:58+03:00 found on that same snapshot) of an OLDER, pre-redesign WordPress-theme rendering of uqn.gov.sa (distinct from the newer Blazor theme captured for /?p=2083 above -- consistent with the site having been redesigned between these two snapshots' dates). This snapshot was fetched directly via curl (HTTP 200, ~215KB) and its own #entry-content-equivalent container ('tdb_single_content' div) was parsed with BeautifulSoup, recovering the FULL VERBATIM decision text: the decision's own preamble names the Minister of Industry and Mineral Resources, cites Council of Ministers Resolution No. 100 (3/2/1444H) as its basis, and explicitly recites the ORIGINAL decision being amended by number and date ('وبعد الاطلاع على القرار الوزاري رقم (1006/1/1442) وتاريخ 9/5/1442هـ، الصادرة بموجبه اللائحة التنفيذية لنظام الاستثمار التعديني') -- this is a direct, primary-source, word-for-word confirmation of the ORIGINAL decision's own number and date from a wholly separate gazette page than the one used for the 166-article body above, i.e. two independent official citations of Decision 1006/1/1442 agreeing exactly. The decision's own three operative clauses state (1) approval of amending the Regulation 'in the form attached to this decision' ('بالصيغة المرافقة لهذا القرار'), (2) publication in the Official Gazette with effect from that publication date, and (3) notification to relevant parties -- signed by Minister بندر بن إبراهيم الخريف. CRITICALLY, the decision's OWN number (3293/1/1444) and date (5/6/1444H) do not appear as visible body text within this specific archived page itself (the page's own visible text refers to the amendment only as 'this decision' without repeating its own reference number inline) -- these were independently confirmed via a targeted WebSearch cross-check (see below), which is why this pass treats the decision NUMBER/DATE as secondary-corroborated (not read verbatim from primary-source body text), while treating the decision's SUBSTANCE/preamble/operative clauses/signatory as directly read from the primary archived page. SECONDARY CORROBORATION OF THE AMENDMENT'S OWN DECISION NUMBER/DATE: a WebSearch query synthesis independently stated 'القرار الوزاري رقم (3293/1/1444) صادر بتاريخ 05/06/1444هـ من وزير الصناعة والثروة المعدنية ... يتعلق هذا القرار بالموافقة على تعديل اللائحة التنفيذية لنظام الاستثمار التعديني الصادرة بالقرار الوزاري رقم (1006/1/1442) وتاريخ 9/5/1442هـ' -- matching this task's own briefed citation exactly and matching the substance/basis (Council of Ministers Resolution 100, 3/2/1444H) read directly from the primary archived decision page above. This is a WebSearch-tool synthesis over indexed web content, not a directly-read, independently-citable single page reached by this pass's own fetch tools -- disclosed as such, and used ONLY for the decision's own reference number/date, not for any claim about which articles it amended or their new wording. WHAT COULD NOT BE OBTAINED -- THE AMENDMENT'S ACTUAL ATTACHED TEXT: the amendment decision's own operative clause explicitly states the amended regulation text is attached SEPARATELY ('بالصيغة المرافقة لهذا القرار'); no such attachment is embedded in, or linked from, the decision's own gazette news page (checked: zero PDF links, zero non-stock-photo attachments in the page's own wp-content/uploads references). Reasonable additional channels were tried and each is documented as unreachable or off-target this pass: (a) istitlaa.ncc.gov.sa's own hosted PDF of this exact regulation (a lead surfaced by WebSearch, on the National Competitiveness Center's public-consultation portal) -- every attempt (direct curl, curl with alternate TLS-version pinning, curl with browser User-Agent and Referer headers, the WebFetch tool, and a Google Docs-viewer proxy wrapping the same URL) failed with either a TLS-layer 'Recv failure: Connection reset by peer' immediately after the Client Hello (i.e. before any HTTP response, ruling out an application-layer 403/404) or an HTTP 503 from the WebFetch tool -- and no archive.org snapshot of this exact PDF URL exists (archive.org/wayback/available returned an empty 'archived_snapshots' object); this is recorded as a genuine, unresolved network-reachability gap for this specific host on this pass, not a deliberate refusal by the host of a specific request; (b) eparticipation.my.gov.sa's own public-consultation page for this regulation -- returned HTTP 403 via the WebFetch tool; (c) FAOLEX (UN FAO's legal database) hosts a PDF at this exact URL surfaced by WebSearch (faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/sau198580.pdf) -- successfully fetched and read in full via pdftotext this pass, but it turned out to be the PARENT LAW (نظام الاستثمار التعديني, the Royal Decree M/140 text) already in this corpus as the mining_investment_law track, NOT the Implementing Regulation -- ruled out as off-target, not evidence for or against the amendment's content; (d) nezams.com -- its own page for the parent Mining Investment Law was read via WebFetch and does not host the Implementing Regulation's text at all (confirmed: no working link to it found on that page); (e) qanoonsa.com -- a site-restricted WebSearch for this regulation's own dedicated page returned no direct hit (only unrelated Ministry of Industry decisions, e.g. reserve-zone designations, appear in its index for this ministry). A further WebSearch synthesis did surface four qualitative, non-verbatim themes reportedly covered by the 1444H amendment (a 30-day cap on certain ministerial approvals/coordination steps; permission to exploit more than one ore type within a single license area; a reduction of the Saudi Geological Survey/mineral-wealth authority's contribution share in joint projects from 25% to 10%; and a new licensing chapter for rock/ore/quarry/salt-pan analysis laboratories) -- these were NOT independently read by this pass from any single directly-fetched, citable page (they surfaced only via the WebSearch tool's own aggregated synthesis, whose exact source page(s) could not be pinned down and independently re-confirmed this pass), and in NO case do they identify a specific article number. Per this corpus's zero-fabrication rule, these unconfirmed, non-verbatim, non-attributed themes are NOT used to tag any of the 166 articles as معدلة, nor to alter any article's stored wording -- doing so would risk presenting guessed/paraphrased content as verified legal text. They are recorded here for transparency only, as a documented lead for a future dedicated pass that can reach istitlaa.ncc.gov.sa or another primary host of the actual attached amendment text. CONCLUSION -- WHY ALL 166 ARTICLES ARE اصلية, NOT a معدلة/اصلية SPLIT: because no reliable, citable, article-level attribution of the 1444H amendment's actual changes was obtained this pass, tagging any specific article as معدلة (without direct textual evidence of what changed) would be a fabricated/guessed attribution -- explicitly disallowed. All 166 articles are therefore recorded اصلية in the sense of 'verified original text as issued by Decision 1006/1/1442 and published in the Official Gazette on 17/5/1442H', NOT in the sense of 'certified unchanged as of today' -- the mirror-image of how real_estate_finance_implementing_regulation records all 31 of its articles اصلية meaning 'currently-governing consolidated text' rather than 'unchanged since 2013'. consolidated_amended_law is recorded FALSE for this track (the stored text is the pre-1444-amendment original, not a consolidated current text) -- the mirror image of that same sibling track's TRUE value. See known_unresolved_discrepancies for the complete, itemized account of every access attempt and every non-obvious judgment call in this build. TEXT QUALITY CHECKS PERFORMED: verified zero HTML/Latin-script leftovers and zero double-space artifacts; decorative mid-word justification tatweel (U+0640) inserted by the source's own WordPress/Word-paste formatting (e.g. 'عمليـة' -> 'عملية', 'إعـادة' -> 'إعادة', 'التأهيـل' -> 'التأهيل', 13 articles affected: 1, 9, 27, 33, 37, 40, 42, 44, 48, 50, 54, 68, 144) was stripped programmatically wherever BOTH the preceding and following characters were themselves Arabic letters (excluding the 'هـ' Hijri-era abbreviation), matching this corpus's own established convention (see debt_collection_regulation's validator _bad_tatweel helper); the result is a clean, gap-free, overlap-free 1..166 numbering run tiling exactly 7 أبواب (Bab) with nested فصول within Bab 1 through 5 (Bab 6 and Bab 7 carry no فصل subdivisions in the source text itself -- confirmed by the total absence of any 'الفصل' heading between the last فصل of Bab 5 and the first article of Bab 7). No translation, paraphrase, or legal interpretation was performed on the Arabic text; English fields are for indexing/discovery only. Read-only over input; deterministic over outputs.

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: Both task-designated uqn.gov.sa URLs (?p=2083 original decision; ?p=21989 amendment decision) returned only the site's generic client-side-rendered application shell on direct fetch this pass (curl HTTP 200 but no article content in the raw response; WebFetch HTTP 503 for both). A confirmed archive.org Wayback Machine snapshot exists for each URL and was used instead: ?p=2083 via snapshot 20251011171315 (a newer Blazor-themed, server-rendered capture of uqn.gov.sa that DOES embed the full article body inline, fetched via the archive's raw 'id_' rendering), and ?p=21989 via snapshot 20230507072534 (an older, pre-redesign WordPress-themed capture, also server-rendered with the decision's full body inline). Both snapshots are treated as PRIMARY (archived copies of the issuing authority's own gazette pages), consistent with this corpus's established BOE_WAYBACK_* precedent for portals whose live version is unreachable or incomplete on a given pass.

The regulation's own text, immediately after Article 166's closing sentence, continues with 6 numbered ملاحق (Appendix 1: mineral categories A/B/C; Appendix 2: Category A royalty-rate table; Appendix 3: Category B royalty-rate table (per-tonne and percentage-of-sales variants); Appendix 4: Category C royalty-rate/minimum-mining-capacity table; Appendix 5: surface-rental fee schedules for exploration and exploitation licenses; Appendix 6: minimum annual exploration-spending schedule) -- all 6 were successfully captured in the same fetch/parse pass as the 166 articles (11 HTML <table> elements total across the full captured page; 10 of the 11 fall within these appendices, the 11th is inside Article 86's own body -- see next entry). These 6 ملاحق are referenced BY specific articles (e.g. Article 110.2, Article 122 and others cite 'الملحق رقم (X)' by number) but are themselves numeric schedules, not additional numbered مواد in the regulation's own numbering scheme. This track's 'articles' collection models exactly the 166 numbered مواد, consistent with this corpus's convention that the numbered المادة is the atomic retrieval unit; the 6 ملاحق are a deliberate, fully-disclosed scope boundary of this pass, not lost or truncated content, and are a documented candidate for a future dedicated schedule/appendix data layer if this corpus later adopts one.

Article 86 (السادسة والثمانون, 'الضمان المالي لرخص مواد البناء') is the ONLY article among the 166 whose own body contains an HTML <table> (a rehabilitation/closure cost schedule by ore type and license term). It was parsed row-by-row -- never naive tag-stripped, which would have silently reordered or merged cell content -- and merged inline into Article 86's own stored text immediately after the sentence introducing it ('حسب الجدول التالي:'), with the header row retained (it carries genuine column-meaning: ore type / license term / two area-tiered cost columns) and each data row rendered as one pipe-delimited prose line preserving the exact published figures.

Ministerial Decision No. (3293/1/1444) dated 5/6/1444H approved amending this Regulation 'in the form attached to that decision' ('بالصيغة المرافقة لهذا القرار') -- confirmed by a direct, primary-source read of the decision's own gazette page (via a Wayback Machine capture of uqn.gov.sa/?p=21989, snapshot 20230507072534), which reproduces the decision's full preamble, its three operative clauses, and the Minister's signature verbatim, and which explicitly names the ORIGINAL decision being amended (1006/1/1442, 9/5/1442هـ) by number and date -- an independent, second primary-source citation of that original decision, agreeing exactly with the citation found on the original decision's own separate gazette page. However, the amendment's own actual attached text (i.e., the amended regulation wording itself) is NOT embedded in, or linked from, that decision's gazette page, and could not be obtained through any other channel attempted this pass: istitlaa.ncc.gov.sa's own hosted PDF of this regulation returned a TLS-layer connection reset on every attempt (direct curl, curl with alternate TLS-version pinning, curl with browser headers, the WebFetch tool, and a Google Docs-viewer proxy of the same URL) with no archive.org snapshot available for that exact PDF URL; eparticipation.my.gov.sa's consultation page for this regulation returned HTTP 403; a FAOLEX PDF surfaced by search turned out to be the PARENT LAW, not this Regulation; nezams.com does not host this Regulation's text at all; and a site-restricted search of qanoonsa.com returned no dedicated page for this regulation. A WebSearch synthesis (not a directly-fetched, independently-re-confirmed single page) surfaced four qualitative, non-verbatim, non-article-attributed themes reportedly covered by the amendment (a 30-day cap on certain ministerial approval/coordination steps; permission to exploit more than one ore type within a single license area; a reduction of the Saudi Geological Survey/mineral-wealth authority's contribution share in joint projects from 25% to 10%; and a new licensing chapter for rock/ore/quarry/salt-pan analysis laboratories) -- these are NOT used to tag any article معدلة or to alter any article's stored wording, since doing so without a directly-verified, citable, article-level source would be a fabricated/guessed attribution. Consequently: (a) all 166 articles are recorded اصلية in this track, meaning verified original text as issued by Decision 1006/1/1442, NOT a certification that no article has since changed; (b) consolidated_amended_law is recorded FALSE (the stored text is the pre-1444-amendment original); (c) both the founding decision and the amending decision are documented together in amendment_history below. Priority follow-up candidate: obtain istitlaa.ncc.gov.sa's hosted PDF (or another primary host of Decision 3293/1/1444's actual attachment) via a network path that can reach that specific host, to perform an article-level diff against this track's stored original text.

The amendment decision's own reference number (3293/1/1444) and date (5/6/1444H) do not appear as visible body text within the archived gazette page used this pass for that decision (that page's own visible text refers to the amendment only as 'this decision' without repeating its own reference number inline); they are instead confirmed via a WebSearch synthesis stating 'القرار الوزاري رقم (3293/1/1444) صادر بتاريخ 05/06/1444هـ ... يتعلق هذا القرار بالموافقة على تعديل اللائحة التنفيذية لنظام الاستثمار التعديني الصادرة بالقرار الوزاري رقم (1006/1/1442) وتاريخ 9/5/1442هـ' -- matching this task's own briefed citation exactly and matching the amendment's basis (Council of Ministers Resolution 100, 3/2/1444H) as independently read from the primary archived decision page. This decision number/date is therefore treated as secondary-corroborated (WebSearch synthesis matching the task's own briefing), while the decision's substance/preamble/operative clauses/signatory are treated as directly read from a primary archived page.

The founding decision's own Gregorian date (9/5/1442H) and the amending decision's own Gregorian date (5/6/1444H) are NOT stated as such on either decision's own gazette page; both are arithmetic conversions computed this pass from standard Hijri calendar epoch/month-length tables (approx. 24/12/2020G and 29/12/2022G respectively), NOT read directly from an official source, and may be off by 1-2 days from the Umm Al-Qura civil calendar actually used administratively in Saudi Arabia. The ONE Gregorian date this track treats as directly source-confirmed (not computed) is the founding regulation's own gazette PUBLICATION date, 1/1/2021G, read verbatim from the date field displayed on the regulation's own official uqn.gov.sa page (17/5/1442H corresponding to 2021-01-01, per that page's own metadata) -- this is 8 days after the computed decision date, a plausible and consistent gap for gazette-publication lag on a freshly-signed decision.
